[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Rust core: VCS-backed records and on-demand materialization[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core-record[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]path to the artifact-file wire, admit byte-free rows, resolve them to a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]new `vcs_backed` status, and add a content-verified git materialization [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]primitive exposed through `sase_core_rs`.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Capture policy — the authorship and version-control decision[/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]

    [#D7D7AF]candidate as store, reference, or skip using a git probe, the repo [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]inventory, the run window, and a per-run byte-copy cap, plus its [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]configuration.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]healthy, and make every read surface materialize VCS-backed content on [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]demand.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
